review.owner: One justified snapshotArtifacts lifecycle owner: run routes flags, writeNewFile publishes verified opaque streams, patchCopy retains image-edit preflight. No fake patch recipes, alternate writer, dependency or new closure. Shared receipt validation serves listing and restore. The finite operation branches remain readable. Receipt byte I/O now reuses readInput rather than duplicating its bounded regular-file read/close/stability responsibility.
review.lifecycle: Safe fixed per-tag artifact/receipt names, exclusive tag reservation, mandatory revision provenance, receipt-last publication and directory sync; duplicate tags refuse. Preview creates no directory. Failed create may leave reserved state intentionally.
review.restore: Receipt fields, tag/regular-file checks and source identity/size/mtime checks precede a complete payload hash; apply rewinds the same descriptor and creates only a new exclusive output. Hash/size bound streaming catches changed bytes during copy.
review.inventory: Sorted directory entries report absent/invalid/incomplete/size-mismatched state; present-unverified and digest_verified=false accurately disclose that listing does not hash contents.
review.publisher: Mandatory reader/nonnegative bounded size/full SHA256 before file creation; stream size+1 catches short/long input, digest checked before sync, bounded-memory hash readback and inode identity verified. Existing inode-owned failure cleanup and close handling remain. Both old production callers pass matching bytes, length and computed artifact hash.
review.limits: Static final source/store/tag/receipt/payload symlinks are rejected by direct Lstat checks. No claim of hostile same-user concurrent namespace safety or atomic live-filesystem snapshot; no in-place restore.

checks.independent_CLI: PASS: exact same9 independent CLI invocations rerun on revised built binary; no new cases.
